import json
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.io import digest,file_digest,write_json
from nisayon.engine.temporal_workflow import load_assessment
from scripts.experiments.audit_temporal_reconciliation import archive_packet
raw=Path("artifacts/engine-integration-001/temporal-integration-001/admission-conformance-001")
root=Path("docs/experiments/results/temporal-integration-001")
report=load_assessment(raw/"assessment",raw/"execution")
rows=[]
for row in report["assignments"]:
 d=json.loads((raw/"assessment"/row["detail"]["path"]).read_bytes());trace=d["inspection"]["trace"]
 rows.append({"assignment":row["assignment"],"integrity":row["integrity"],"process_outcome":row["process_outcome"],"trace_sha256":digest(trace),"admissions":[e for e in trace["events"] if e["kind"]=="queue_admitted"],"dispatches":[e for e in trace["events"] if e["kind"]=="action_dispatched"],"refusals":[e for e in trace["events"] if e["kind"]=="dispatch_refused"],"reference_assessment":d["reference_assessment"],"original_execution_costs":row["original_execution_costs"]})
collision=next(r for r in rows if r["assignment"]["id"]=="Y02-rejected-conflicting-delivery--conventional")
assert [e["value"] for e in collision["dispatches"]]==[1]
assert collision["admissions"][1]["admitted"]==[] and collision["admissions"][1]["replaced"]==[]
assert collision["admissions"][1]["reason"]=="chunk_identity_collision"
assert collision["dispatches"][0]["age_guard"]["lower_ns"]==20_000_000
assert collision["reference_assessment"]["age_readings"][0]["interval_used"]==[120_000_000,120_000_000]
replacement=next(r for r in rows if r["assignment"]["id"]=="Y03-stale-distinct-replacement--conventional")
assert replacement["admissions"][1]["replaced"]==["c0:0"] and not replacement["dispatches"]
archive=archive_packet(raw,root/"admission-conformance-001.tar.gz")
result={"schema":"nisayon.temporal-admission-conformance.v1","execution_source_commit":"601b0b8e072b4a439c09e4fc5305dbf44aaa7e46","evaluation_delivery":"8e5465051a583823ce8bf3914846e71046fbdeee","reference_module_sha256":file_digest(Path("src/nisayon/evaluation/temporal.py")),"capture":json.loads((raw/"capture.json").read_bytes()),"frozen_suite_sha256":file_digest(root/"frozen-admission-conformance.v1.json"),"assignments":rows,"archive":archive,"findings":["Y02 ordinary producer rejects the conflicting delivery and dispatches original value 1 with exact age 20 ms; the reference reads 120 ms from the refused later response. Collision invalidation versus admission-bound interpretation requires owner disposition.","Y03 ordinary dispatch-only policy replaces the fresh queued action with an already stale newer-request chunk, then refuses it at dispatch. This is observed policy behavior and a possible usefulness improvement, not a violation of the frozen latest-request rule. Any new admission guard must be separately named and provided to the conventional comparator too."],"new_simulator_executions":0,"scientific_acceptance":"not_granted"}
write_json(root/"admission-conformance-001.json",result)
print(json.dumps({"records":8,"collision_producer_age_ns":20_000_000,"collision_reference_age_ns":120_000_000,"replacement_dispatches":0,"archive_bytes":archive["bytes"]}))
